title: Bas Thodi Der Aur
body:
Jab ho chuke shaheed Shanshah e Karbala
Nanhi si ek yateema ka kurta bhi jal gaya
bacchi ko yaad baba ki jis dam rula gayi
Baaba.. Baba pukaarte hue maqtal mein aa gayi
Awaz di sakina s.a ko Maula Hussain ne
Ilayya Ilayya Sakina Sakina
Ye baba se ro kar pukari hazeena
Seene pe sona chahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)
Kuch aaj zyada... thak si gayi hu mai baba
Seene pe sona chahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)
1) Ye shaam e ghareeba hai baba
Ek zulm ka toofaan hai baaba
(Wehshat ka saamaa hai baba —2)
Jungle ke andhere, mein sehmi hu mai baaba
2) Kyu zaalim mujhko sataate hai
Kyu maarke mujhko rulaate hai
Daaman mein aag lagate hai 2—
Ab aapke paas, aake chupi hu mai baaba
3) Aagosh mein sab ke rehti thi
Ammu ke saaye mein palti thi
(Paidal bhi kaha mai chalti thi —2)
Haye daud ke kitna,Â aaj chali hu mai baba
4) Mujhko nahi apni pyaas ka gham
Tadpaata hai khaali ek alam
(Asghar ko lagaya teer e sitam —2)
Bhaiyya ko apne,dhundh rahi hu mai baba
5) Baaba chaadar bhi cheeni gai
Roti hai amma aur phuphi
Ab apna nahi monis koi 2—
Dekho kitni aafat mei padi hu mai baaba
6) Bhai hai kabse gash mein pade
Ab kaun hai sabke hai laashe
(Phir shimr kahi naa ajaaye —2)
Ye soch ke har dam, darti hu mai baba
7) Aye baba zara aankhe kholo
mein kab se bulaati hu bolo
(Sath apni sakina ke solo —2)
Phir kaise miloge, soch rahi hu mai baba
8) Ye Hashmi benno ki hai sada
Jaari rahe yunhi rasme aza
Usko hai Nigar apna pursa
Jo kehti rahi, naazo ki pali hu main Baba
Seene pe sona chaahti hu mai baba
(Bas thodi der aur —2)
